rule: Do not delete or skip these tests. Do not invert assertions merely to make the new implementation pass. Document every changed assertion and its authorization rationale.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A phone-approved bounded file operation runs without any extra prompt (no request, file written, completes).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phoneApprove -> until completed; requests(view).length === 0; file written.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: phoneApprove -> waitAsk filesystem.promote; requests(view).length === 1 (only the promotion); note.txt absent until promotion; phoneRespond on the promotion rejects DESKTOP_ONLY; workstation respond promotes; file written; authority remote; launched 0.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 D2 stages every device write; the only remaining prompt is the workstation-only promotion. Keeps the no-write-prompt requirement and adds a negative regression that a device cannot promote.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: Workstation revocation of a device ends every outstanding approval it granted (sign-out variant was disabled).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: for (const signOut of [false])
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: for (const signOut of [false, true]); the existing assertions (revoked envelope, state stopped, late respond refused, retry refused, no launch) now apply to self sign-out too.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 D5: self sign-out now revokes the envelopes the device granted and stops those Missions. Comment above the test updated (old 'keeps approvals' statement was obsolete). Test name kept.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A phone cannot start a workstation-approved Mission that can run code; remote-approved ones it may; a benign phone-started Mission completes.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone mission.start of a benign write completes directly.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: promoteStaged(env, benign.id) inserted after the phone start, before the completed wait.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: The device-started write is staged (F02 D2); completion now needs the workstation promotion. Phone-start refusal assertions unchanged.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: The workstation prompt for code execution lists files paired-device authority changed in the Mission.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: write path lib.json (root); promotion not present; regex /paired-device authority: "lib\.json"/.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: write path data/lib.json; promoteStaged inserted before the terminal ask; regex /paired-device authority: "[^"]*lib\.json"/.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: A root .json is CONFIGURATION under F02, so the data example uses data/ (PHONE_SAFE_DATA). The listing now shows absolute JSON-escaped paths, so the regex accepts any prefix. The listing requirement is unchanged.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A phone's one-time answer never reaches outside the reviewed envelope; only the workstation's answer extends roots; the outside write lands after the workstation allows it.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: regex /outside the approved write scope/ on the first ask; device answer simulated by saveRequest on the live ask with resolvedBy PHONE; workstation allow then waited for completed.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: regex /classified UNKNOWN \(outside the step's working folder\)/ on the first ask; device answer simulated on a separate request record id 'f01-r18-device-answer' with resolvedAt now; workstation allow followed by promoteStaged before waiting for completed. The phone-rejection and no-root-from-device assertions are unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 refuses out-of-root writes with the classification reason first. The old device-answer simulation stamped the live ask's lifecycle EXPIRED (first stamp wins), a test artifact that invalidated the real workstation answer. The workstation's write is staged and needs its promotion.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: Code never runs over unreviewed paired-device changes from another Mission, under any envelope or provider.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: Mission A phone-approved edit of helper.json, completed; pendingRemoteChanges length 1; later a second phone edit of helper.json.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed(env, 'helper.json', ...) (unreviewed change recorded with runId 'seed'); same pendingRemoteChanges length 1 assertion; second phone edit replaced by seedUnreviewed again. All gate assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 stages device writes, so they no longer land unreviewed. The review gate is exercised as defense in depth by seeding the unreviewed change directly, as specified.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: The review gate is Host-wide: code in any folder waits for unreviewed paired-device changes.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone-approved edit of helper.json as Mission a, then a terminal decision check from other folders.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed(env, 'helper.json', ...) replaces the phone edit; decision assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Same as R20: device writes are staged, so the unreviewed change is seeded to exercise the Host-wide gate.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A paired-device change never lands under workstation-approved code that is already running; the held change lands after the workstation allows it.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: helper.json at root, phone edit held, workstation allow, then wait for completed; final content checked at root.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: data/helper.json (script reads data/helper.json); promoteStaged(env, edit.id) inserted after the held allow; final content checked at data/helper.json. Hold, phone-refusal, running-code and ran.txt=='host' assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Root .json is CONFIGURATION (promotion refused). The held change is staged, so the workstation's promotion is required.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A paired-device change is recorded for review even when the write fails after starting (no unrecorded change).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone write onto a directory; expects a failed filesystem.write run and a pendingRemoteChanges row for folder.txt.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: Renamed to 'a device write onto a non-file destination never starts, so no unrecorded change can exist'. waitAsk filesystem.write: desktopRequired true; reason matches classified UNKNOWN (destination exists and is not a regular file); phone allow rejects DESKTOP_ONLY; zero filesystem.write runs; folder untouched; no pendingRemoteChanges row for it.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 classifies the destination before anything starts, so a device write never reaches the 'fails after starting' point. The new assertions are a negative regression for the same safety property (nothing unrecorded changed). Coverage gap: a device write that fails after touching disk is no longer reachable through filesystem.write.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A workstation review acknowledges only the paired-device changes its prompt shows (13 changes: 12 shown, 1 more).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: two phone-approved batches of 7 and 6 writes, then expects pendingRemoteChanges length 13.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: 13 seedUnreviewed calls (f-00..f-12); pendingRemoteChanges length 13 kept; all paging assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Device writes are staged, so 13 unreviewed changes are seeded directly.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: Git reads wait for review of paired-device changes.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone-approved write of conv.json, completed; git decisions asked with remoteReview length 1.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed(env, 'conv.json', '1') replaces the phone edit; git decision assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Seeded unreviewed change, as device writes are staged.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A provider review with more changes than one prompt lists asks the next page instead of failing.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: two phone batches totalling 13 writes (g-00..g-12), then a provider ask.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: 13 seedUnreviewed calls (g-00..g-12); provider paging assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Device writes are staged, so the 13 unreviewed changes are seeded.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A paired device writes only inert data and documents; code, agent configuration and downloads stay on the workstation.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: safe list includes out/result.json and conf/values.yaml; refused list does not include them.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: safe list uses exports/result.json (a data folder); refused list adds out/result.json and conf/values.yaml (CONFIGURATION).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 classifies JSON/YAML outside a recognized data folder as CONFIGURATION (safer). conf/ is a configuration folder. The coverage (safe data passes, config refused) is preserved.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: Removing a file adds no code: remoteExecutionRefusal(filesystem.delete, old.mjs) is null.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: assert null for old.mjs.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: assert null for old.txt (ordinary document); assert DESKTOP_ONLY refusal for old.mjs (execution-relevant file).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 applies the same classification to device deletes, so deleting execution-relevant files is workstation-only. The 'removing a document adds no code' premise is kept and a negative regression is added.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: The workstation reviews the content of paired-device changes, not only their names.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone-approved note write of notes.txt, completed; then a terminal ask with the content in reason.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed(env, 'notes.txt', body) replaces the phone write; content, sha256 and git-in-flight assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Device writes are staged, so the unreviewed change is seeded.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A review prompt shows the whole changed file, or says plainly that it cannot.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: two phone-approved writes (padded.txt, huge.txt), then a terminal ask.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed for padded.txt and huge.txt; all prompt and projection assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Device writes are staged, so the unreviewed changes are seeded.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A workstation Mission a phone started is a paired-device actor for the hold and the review; its write is recorded for review.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: after the held allow and completion, pendingRemoteChanges includes w.txt.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: promoteStaged(env, write.id) after the held allow; then staging.forMission(write.id) has a record for w.txt with promotionState PROMOTED. The deviceDriven, hold and running-code assertions are unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: F02 records a device change as reviewed when it is promoted (the promotion acknowledges it), so the review record is now the promoted staging record.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: A superseded review re-ask shows every change it acknowledges (2 changes, with content).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: two phone writes (a.txt, then b.txt with SECOND-CHANGE-CONTENT) between the ask and the workstation answer.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed for a.txt before the run; seedUnreviewed for b.txt after the first ask; one direct workstation write (bump.txt) added so the mutation sequence moves, as any file-changing run does. The supersede and re-ask assertions are unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Seeded changes make no capability run, so the mutation sequence needs one real project mutation to trigger the 'Project files changed' supersede path. The direct write adds no paired-device change.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: Changed-file text cannot imitate review prompt structure.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone-approved write of forge.txt with forged listing text.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed(env, 'forge.txt', same content); listing assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Device writes are staged, so the unreviewed change is seeded.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: seedUnreviewed(env, 'secret.txt', same content); workstation/phone assertions unchanged.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: Device writes are staged, so the unreviewed change is seeded.

remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).originalRequirement: No Host response to a paired device carries the review listing (state, inbox, agents, mission.get).
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).before: phone write completes; a workstation terminal mission then shows the sentinel in its review prompt; device /state and device mission.get checked for the sentinel.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).after: phone write waits for the filesystem.promote request (the workstation promotion prompt is the review listing); workstation mission.get includes the sentinel; device /state does not; device mission.get requests (not the phone's own step parameters) do not include the sentinel and carry no promotion field. Terminal-mission part removed.
remote-authority.test.ts (F01 suite).authorizationRationale: The review listing now reaches the workstation through the promotion prompt. The device's own plan parameters legitimately name its content, so the device check targets its requests and promotion records.
